 The 946 DESTROYED Jimmy Uso in message to Roman Reigns 
 02:34 
 Royce Keys leads a rampage against Jimmy Uso in statement fashion. Catch WWE action on the ESPN App, Netflix, USA Network, CW Network, Peacock, Rumble and more. 
 Shinsuke Nakamura def. Tama Tonga 
 02:48 
 Shinsuke Nakamura goes one-on-one with Tama Tonga of The MFTs. Catch WWE action on the ESPN App, Netflix, USA Network, CW Network, Peacock, Rumble and more. 
 Shinsuke Nakamura picked up a major win on behalf of Bakusai as he took down Tama Tonga of The MFTs. 
 As one half of the WWE Tag Team Champions, Tonga was aiming to exact payback on Nakamura for Kyoki's theft of the sacred Tongan Staff. 
 Kyoki once again tried to steal it, and that move allowed Nakamura to hit a match-ending Kinshasa.
 Finn Bálor and Gunther got into an explosive melee 
 02:55 
 Physicality erupts between Finn Bálor and Gunther. Catch WWE action on the ESPN App, Netflix, USA Network, CW Network, Peacock, Rumble and more. 
 Charlotte Flair returned to bring the fight to Jade Cargill 
 03:01 
 “The Queen” Charlotte Flair helps Alexa Bliss, Tatum Paxley and Bayley stave off Jade Cargill, B-Fab, Michin and Fatal Influence. Catch WWE action on the ESPN App, Netflix, USA Network, CW Network, Peacock, Rumble and more. 
 The WWE Women's Tag Team Title Match was swiftly interrupted by Alexa Bliss, Tatum Paxley, Bayley and a returning Charlotte Flair.
 The Queen attacked Jade Cargill in her epic comeback, leaving both sides at a standstill. 
 Liv Morgan to Chelsea Green: “You’re a charity case" 
 03:04 
 Women’s World Champion Liv Morgan gets personal and verbally unloads on WWE Women’s Champion Chelsea Green. Catch WWE action on the ESPN App, Netflix, USA Network, CW Network, Peacock, Rumble and more. 
 Damian Priest def. Nathan Frazer via referee stoppage 
 03:03 
 Damian Priest goes to extreme lengths in taking out Nathan Frazer and Axiom. Catch WWE action on the ESPN App, Netflix, USA Network, CW Network, Peacock, Rumble and more. 
 Damian Priest sent a major message that he is not to be messed with.
 The former World Heavyweight Champion brutalized Nathan Frazer in a stunning display, forcing the referee to stop the match after a Razor's Edge on the announce table.
 Frazer's tag team partner Axiom attempted to get payback for his partner, but Priest sent him flying into the ring post.
 Kevin Owens def. CM Punk | No Holds Barred Match 
 23:02 
 CM Punk and Kevin Owens clash in a No Holds Barred Match. Catch WWE action on the ESPN App, Netflix, USA Network, CW Network, Peacock, Rumble and more. 
 The epic No Holds Barred Match between Kevin Owens and CM Punk saw KO walk away as the victor.
 With no rules, Owens and Punk took their battle into the WWE Universe as they brawled throughout the Barclays Center, using weapons and production equipment to brutalize each other. 
 The action spilled back into the ringside area as Punk delivered a huge elbow drop through the announce table, but not even that was enough to win the match.
 When Owens attempted to end the bout with a series of steel chairs set up in the ring, Punk countered and sent his rival crashing onto them from the top rope.
 After sending himself and Punk plummeting through a pair of tables at ringside with a Fisherman Buster from the apron, Owens withstood a GTS and punched out Punk with a steel chain wrapped around his hand to earn the victory in an instant classic.
